Two page openings left (if the failed one counted). Opening the forum and Baron transcripts.I found four statements from 2025 that look like candidates. All of them come from transcripts on singjupost.com, which are third-party transcriptions, not official ones. None of them matches the four claims you already have recorded.

- **Y Combinator AI Startup School, 19 June 2025:** Musk said digital superintelligence would arrive this year or next year "for sure". This is the clearest dated AGI-type prediction I found.
- **US–Saudi Investment Forum, 19 November 2025:** He said work would be optional in "ten, twenty years". The question he was answering was about AI and jobs.
- **Nikhil Kamath podcast, 30 November 2025:** He said "in less than 20 years… 10 or 15 years" AI and robotics would make working optional.
- **Same Kamath podcast:** He said Optimus would start production at scale "hopefully some of next year". This one is borderline because it reads like a production plan. You may want to drop it.

**Left out on purpose:**
- At the same forum he said solar-powered AI satellites would be the cheapest way to do AI compute within five years. I treated that as a data-centre forecast, so it is not a candidate.
- On the Joe Rogan show he predicted full rocket reusability next year. That is not about AI.

**What I could not check:**
- **Rogan, Joe Rogan Experience #2404 (31 October 2025):** The transcript page loaded only partly, and the AI part was missing. A second transcript site refused the request.
- **Ron Baron's conference (14 November 2025):** Opening the transcript timed out. That is where he reportedly put a 10% chance on Grok 5 reaching AGI. Reports say Grok 5 was due in the first quarter of 2026, but I saw that only in search snippets.
- **Other 2025 claims seen only in search snippets:** an "AGI by 2026" remark to xAI staff (from leaked-meeting coverage) and a December podcast with Peter Diamandis. I have not quoted any of these.
